## About
Pignatelli Collision is a family owned and operated collision repair shop in Richland Hills, started by Jon Pignatelli and his wife Lauren. Before opening the shop, Jon worked as a certified master collision technician at a dealership, and he has been doing auto body work in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex for a long time.
Our goal is simple: bring your vehicle back to its pre-collision condition and treat you like family while we do it. You get dealership quality work in a more personal, friendly setting.
We handle everything from major damage to small cosmetic fixes, including hail damage, paintless dent repair, frame work and paint refinishing. Making all things new is our slogan, and it's how we try to run the shop.

## Services
- Collision repair: A full range of collision repair, from major vehicle damage to finer cosmetic issues.
- Paintless dent repair: Small and large dents pulled out while keeping the original factory paint.
- Hail damage repair: Dents left behind by hail storms, taken care of so your car looks right again.
- Auto frame repair: Frame repair after a collision.
- Auto paint refinishing: Fixing chips and scratches before stone chips can turn into rust.
- Auto body repair: Complete body repair for customers around the DFW area.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I schedule an appointment online?
A: Yes. You can set up your appointment online, or give us a call.

Q: Will you help with my insurance claim?
A: One customer shared that after his wife's accident, Jon and Lauren dealt with all the paperwork with the insurance company. Call us and we can talk through your situation.
